outcome: Ergonomic factors during ultrasound-guided transversus abdominis plane block
cohort: 21 patients undergoing inguinal hernia repair under spinal anaesthesia, with 10 experienced and 11 novice anaesthesiologists performing the blocks
finding: Performance of ultrasound-guided transversus abdominis plane block was ergonomically suboptimal and varied among operators, with experienced operators demonstrating better ergonomics.
